He is gesturing with his hands while discussing the text displayed on the left of the screen. The text, titled "FINTECH WORKFORCE TO GROW BY 19% IN NEXT DECADE DUE TO AI While incumbents expect AI to reduce their headcount by 9%," outlines a study by the Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF) at the University of Cambridge's Judge Business School, that reveals how AI is impacting financial services. Key points include the expectation that incumbent financial institutions will reduce their headcount by 9% by 2030, while fintech companies anticipate growing their workforce by 19% in the next decade. The text also touches on the reasons behind these trends, such as the automation of tasks by incumbents and the creation of AI-based products and services by fintechs. Additionally, it discusses the struggle of both incumbents and fintechs to attract and retain tech talent, highlighting culture mismatches for incumbents and competition from big tech companies for fintechs.
